## Purpose
G3 Test planning: decides what the code will be held to before it exists, including up to 3 realistic inputs written by the model.

## Responsibilities
- **`MAX_LLM_CASES = 3`.**
- **`TestPlanLayer.process`:**
  - when `profile.wants_llm_cases` and there are properties, calls `_realistic_inputs`;
  - `profile.build_test_plan`;
  - a weak plan adds the warning "no input is known to be valid, so the tests can only show the code does not crash — add worked examples to the spec";
  - emits the case counts.
- **`_realistic_inputs`:**
  - `llm.complete_json("testplan", …)`;
  - keeps only schema properties;
  - drops inputs that fail the schema (emitting "dropped a generated input that breaks the schema");
  - keeps at most 3;
  - a model failure warns "realistic test inputs unavailable (…); using schema samples only".

## Key elements
`TestPlanLayer`.

## Control flow
As above.

## Data, state and side effects
A model call on the testplan route.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `prompts/testplan`, `testplan.validate_input` and the profiles.

## Error handling and edge cases
- The plan degrades gracefully when the model fails.

## Nuances and gotchas
Model-written inputs are held to success only if they pass the input schema.

As described.
